items.title: Google DeepMind releases a global map of forest types
items.summary: Google DeepMind and Google Research, working with the World Resources Institute and IIASA, released Forest Typology 2020, a global 10-meter-resolution map distinguishing six forest and land-use types. They also shared an early time series tracking changes from 2017 to 2025, including natural forests converted to plantations or farms.
